description: Hi, I’m Hiba! CS engineer & full-stack dev (Node, Django, React Native).Water scarcity isn't a future threat—it's here. I'm building a NASA-powered crop rotation engine to give real farmers actionable solutions.
summary:
TerraRota is a trilingual (Arabic, French, English) agricultural platform for Moroccan farmers facing climate variability. We built a full-stack application that ingests real NASA Earth observation data (NASA POWER, MODIS, SMAP) to compute precise agro-climatic indicators.

Our deterministic agronomic engine (based on INRA/FAO rules) generates explainable 3-year crop rotation scenarios and simulates "What-If" climate anomalies. To ensure accessibility, we integrated two distinct voice agents powered by local AI (Ollama) and Edge TTS:

Ami Ahmed, the wise agronomist, explains soil health and crop rotations.

Lalla Fatima, the climate expert, alerts on water stress and frost risks.

These agents are agentic: they don't just talk—they interact with the app (auto-navigating to the simulator or weather page based on the farmer's voice command). The AI strictly acts as a linguistic and pedagogical layer, translating pre-calculated, NASA-backed results without making decisions.

Why it matters: By combining space technology with sovereign, privacy-first AI and culturally resonant voice personas, TerraRota empowers smallholders to optimize water usage, restore soil nitrogen, and secure yields against climate shocks—all in their local language.
details:
TerraRota — Cultivating Resilience from Space

What does it do / How does it work?

TerraRota is a trilingual (Arabic, French, English) agricultural decision-support platform with two distinct user modes:

  1. Farmer Mode: A simplified, guided workflow (3 steps) that queries real-time NASA APIs (POWER, MODIS, SMAP) to compute agro-climatic indicators. A deterministic engine (INRA/FAO rules) generates ranked crop recommendations and 3-year rotation scenarios.
  2. Specialist/Expert Mode: A deep-dive interface for agronomists and researchers, exposing raw scientific data (aridity index, GDD, frost risk), soil typology, scientific evidence (INRA/FAO/ICARDA), and a "What-If" climate simulator.

Voice & Agentic AI: We integrated two distinct voice agents powered by Edge TTS (neural voices) and a local LLM (Ollama):

  • Ami Ahmed (عمي أحمد): The wise agronomist, explaining crop rotations and soil health in Darija.
  • Lalla Fatima (لالة فاطمة): The climate and water expert, alerting on drought, frost, and irrigation needs.

These agents are agentic: they don't just answer questions, they interact with the app (e.g., auto-navigating to the weather page or simulator based on the farmer's voice command).

What benefits does it have?

  • For farmers: Voice interaction in Darija with two specialized agents (Ahmed for crops, Fatima for water/climate), actionable 3-year rotation plans, and a one-click "Demo Mode".
  • For specialists: Full traceability of NASA data, access to scientific references, and a scenario simulator to analyze crop score variations under climate stress.
  • For all: A sovereign, privacy-first AI architecture (local Ollama LLM + Edge TTS) that explains data without making agronomic decisions—preventing AI hallucinations.

What is the intended impact?

To empower both Moroccan smallholders and agricultural engineers. For farmers, it means securing yields and saving water through an intuitive, voice-first interface that respects their oral tradition. For specialists, it provides a decision-support tool to design resilient agricultural policies and train the next generation of agronomists. TerraRota bridges the gap between raw NASA data and the Moroccan field, from grassroots to institutional levels.

What tools, languages, hardware, or software did you use?

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Leaflet (maps), Recharts (charts), jsPDF (PDF export), Web Speech API (speech-to-text input).
  • Backend: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic.
  • AI: Ollama (local LLM for agentic reasoning and pedagogical explanation), Edge TTS (neural voice synthesis for Arabic, French, English).
  • Data: NASA POWER, MODIS, SMAP, SoilGrids (ISRIC/FAO), INRA Morocco rules.
  • Hardware: Runs entirely on a standard laptop (local AI, no cloud required).

How is your project creative?

TerraRota's creativity lies in its dual-mode architecture, dual-agent design, and hybrid AI approach:

  1. Dual-mode: It serves both the low-literacy farmer (voice, 3 steps) and the agronomist (raw data, citations, simulator).
  2. Dual-agent: Two distinct personas (Ami Ahmed for crops, Lalla Fatima for climate) mirror the oral tradition of Moroccan farming, where knowledge is passed by elders.
  3. Agentic AI: The agents don't just talk—they act. They interpret the farmer's intent and navigate the app automatically (e.g., opening the simulator or weather page).
  4. Explainable & Sovereign AI: Decision-making (deterministic engine) is separated from explanation (local LLM). The AI never invents agronomic advice—it translates and explains pre-calculated, NASA-backed results. Using Ollama + Edge TTS locally ensures data privacy and works offline.
